rows.text: OBJECTIVE ITEM: Roll again if the captain is at a space port, otherwise an Objective Item has been found that may be required for the current mission (check the away mission’s details). If it’s not needed, it is in- stead an ancient alien artefact (AAA) worth 75c. 75c
*(L) ACUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +3 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon. 105c
*(L) BRUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +3 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon. 105c
*(L) SPEED ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +3 Def against enemy’s next damage roll. 150c
*(L) ARMOUR UPGRADE: Roll on table A – Armour and add “(L)” before its name. It gains +0.4 Def and gains +200 credit to its value and 40 credits to its fix cost. +200c/+40c
*(L) ACID WRAP: Use to deduct -4 pips from the acid track. 160c
*(L) MED PACK: Use to replenish up to 8 lost HP. 160c
*(L) BRAIN ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +15 Int to next test. 225c
*(L) MIGHT ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +15 Str to next test. 225c
*(L) NIMBLE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +15 Dex to next test. 225c
*(L) CLEANSING WRAP: Use to deduct -4 pips from the plague track. 260c
CYBERCON™ PATCH: Roll on table I – Implants +5 for the patch that is found. Add “Patch” after its name when you add it to the log sheet. 200c
*(L) KARMA TONIC: Use to add +15 to a result when rolling on the next table. 300c
*(L) ENDURING KARMA TONIC: Use to gain 2 karma point. 300c
*(L) BRAIN BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +15 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track. 450c
*(L) MIGHT BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +15 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track. 450c
*(L) NIMBLE BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +15 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track. 450c
*(L) ENDURING DEX TONIC : Use to gain 2 point of primary Dex. 600c
*(L) ENDURING INT TONIC: Use to gain 2 point of primary Int. 600c
*(L) ENDURING STR TONIC: Use to gain 2 point of primary Str. 600c
*(L) ENDURING HEALTH TONIC: Use to gain 2 point of primary HP. 800c
*(L) WEAPON UPGRADE: Roll on table W – Weapon and add “(L)” before its name. Add +3 to its Dmg value. It gains +900 credit to its value. +900c
CYBERCON™ IMPLANT: Roll on table I – Implants +5 for the implant that is found. 800c
*(L) ENDURING LIFE TONIC: Use to gain 2 Life point. 2000c
UPGRADED TRAPPING: A more valuable trapping has been found. Roll on table TC – Trappings C -
POWERED ARMOUR: Powered armour has been found. Roll on table A – Armour +5 for the armour and then on table P - Powers +5 for its power and adjust its value. -
POWERED WEAPON: A powered weapon has been found. Roll on table W – Weapons +5 for the weapon and then on table P - Powers +5 for its power and adjust its value. -
